title: Affine external direct image versus constant-section tensor coefficients
statement: Let k be a field [def-weil-field], X and Y schemes [def-pc-scheme], and f:X → Spec(k) and g:Y → Spec(k) morphisms. Assume X is quasi-compact and f has affine diagonal. Let F and G be sheaves of modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], quasi-coherent on X and Y [pqf-def-coherent]. Give Gamma(X,F) its k-module structure scalarObj f F at the top open [def-sc-field-linear-module-cohomology-operations]. On the full subcategory of affine opens of Y, the restriction of picardConstantSectionsTensor k Y g Gamma(X,F) G [lem-sc-picard-constant-sections-tensor-basis] is isomorphic to the underlying presheaf of pr2_*(externalCupCoefficients f g F G) [pqf-def-cohomology]. All types and schemes lie in the same universe. No basis or coproduct occurs.

source.place: Tag 0BED, lemma-kunneth, affine-open degree-zero calculation; read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0BED

proof.text: On each affine V, presheaf scalar extension along the identity functor is sectionwise extension of scalars, so the tensor coefficient presheaf has value (O_Y(V) tensor_k Gamma(X,F)) tensor_{O_Y(V)} G(V), canonically Gamma(X,F) tensor_k G(V). Balance gives the inverse and scalar linearity.

Use the open-restriction coefficient comparison to identify sections of the external direct image over V with the external sections on X times V, then use the bijective affine-right external global-section comparison. The pure-tensor formula proves O_Y(V)-linearity and restriction compatibility. Assemble component isomorphisms with PresheafOfModules.isoMk, including empty opens and zero modules.

proof_origin.place: Tag 0BED, ordinary direct-image degree-zero tensor calculation; read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0BED

mathlib_searches.query: The direct image of external tensor coefficients on affine opens is the scalar extension of global sections tensored with the second coefficient presheaf
Sections of external tensor product of quasi coherent modules on X times an affine scheme equal tensor product of global sections, naturally on affine open subsets
mathlib_searches.results: Eight hits: pointwise presheaf tensor construction and affine-open section lemmas; no external direct-image comparison.
PresheafOfModules.isoMk and its component formulas assemble isomorphisms, but do not supply the geometric components.
No Mathlib algebraic-geometry hits. The library externalGlobalSectionsTensor_bijective_of_isAffine_right and externalSectionsComponent_openComparison provide the planned component ingredients.

from.place: Affine presheaf comparison, factored through constant global-sections tensor coefficients

lean.statement:
theorem exists_external_constant_sections_tensor_comparison
    (k : Type w) [Field k] (X Y : Scheme.{w})
    (f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) (g : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
    [CompactSpace X] [IsAffineHom (pullback.diagonal f)]
    (F : X.Modules) (G : Y.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent] [G.IsQuasicoherent] :
    Nonempty ((PresheafOfModules.pushforward₀
        (ObjectProperty.ι (fun V : Y.Opens ↦ IsAffineOpen V)) Y.ringCatSheaf.obj).obj
        (picardConstantSectionsTensor k Y g (scalarObj f F (op ⊤)) G) ≅
      (PresheafOfModules.pushforward₀
        (ObjectProperty.ι (fun V : Y.Opens ↦ IsAffineOpen V)) Y.ringCatSheaf.obj).obj
        ((RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage (pullback.snd f g).toLRSHom.toShHom).obj
          (externalCupCoefficients f g F G)).val)
